{"code":"import Mathlib

theorem fatem_020_field_ideal_eq_bot_or_top {F : Type*} [Field F] (I : Ideal F) :
    I = 0 ∨ I = ⊤ := by
  by_cases h : I = 0
  · exact Or.inl h
  · -- Case: I ≠ 0
    -- Since I is not the zero ideal, there exists a non-zero element in I
    have h_exists : ∃ x : F, x ∈ I ∧ x ≠ 0 := by
      -- Use the fact that I ≠ ⊥ (0) implies there is a non-zero element
      have h_ne_bot : I ≠ ⊥ := by simpa using h
      -- Use Submodule.exists_ne_zero_mem (Ideal is a Submodule)
      exact Submodule.exists_ne_zero_mem h_ne_bot
    obtain ⟨x, hx_mem, hx_ne_zero⟩ := h_exists
    -- In a field, every non-zero element is a unit
    have hx_unit : IsUnit x := by
      rw [isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
      exact hx_ne_zero
    -- The ideal generated by a unit is the top ideal
    have h_span_top : Ideal.span {x} = ⊤ := by
      rw [Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top]
      exact hx_unit
    -- Since x ∈ I, the span of {x} is contained in I
    have h_span_le : Ideal.span {x} ≤ I := by
      apply Ideal.span_le
      intro y hy
      exact hx_mem
    -- Therefore, ⊤ ≤ I, which implies I = ⊤
    have h_I_top : I = ⊤ := by
      apply le_antisymm
      · -- I ≤ ⊤ is always true
        exact le_top
      · -- ⊤ ≤ I
        rw [h_span_top] at h_span_le
        exact h_span_le
    exact Or.inr h_I_top"}
